chain_words.nuance: mildly pleasing and likely to catch interest
pleasant to see, hear or use
general word for something that draws attention and admiration
so appealing that one cannot resist it

explanation: These words all describe something that appeals to people, from mildly interesting to impossible to resist.

usage_notes.difference: 'Attractive' is a general word for something that looks good; 'stunning' describes a much stronger, more striking impression.
